"""Accounting-only join of frozen overrides: no fitting, inference, selection or grading."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast, collections, gzip, hashlib, json, math

D=Path(__file__).parent
BASE=Path('/tmp/NFL-CATEGORY-RELEASE-20261112')
S=BASE/'selector-inputs'; R=BASE/'selector-replay'
def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protocol=load(R/'PROTOCOL.json')
ranker=BASE/'website/tools/weekly_selected_rankings.py'
assert sha(ranker)==protocol['production_ranker_sha256']
for node in ast.parse(ranker.read_text()).body:
    if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='POLICY' for t in node.targets):
        policy=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
assert policy['version']=='selected-projection-gap-v1'
assert sha(S/'P1_TYPED_POINTS_W1_W8.json')==protocol['P1_projection_sha256']
points=load(S/'P1_TYPED_POINTS_W1_W8.json')['rows']
index={(r['origin'],r['game_id'],r['player_id']):r for r in points}
assert len(index)==len(points)
bridges=collections.defaultdict(set)
bridge_paths=['C/sources/propline-v7/historical_identity_crosswalk.json.gz','C/artifacts/reliability-v8/IDENTITY_CROSSWALK.json.gz']
for path in bridge_paths:
    for r in json.loads(gzip.decompress((S/path).read_bytes())):
        native=str(r.get('native_player_id',''))
        if r.get('player_id') and native.startswith('espn:') and native[5:].isdigit(): bridges[native[5:]].add(r['player_id'])
picks=load(R/'PICKS.local.json')
canonical_receipt=load(R/'review/CANONICAL_MEMBERSHIP_RECEIPT.json')
canonical=[{k:r[k] for k in canonical_receipt['fields']} for r in picks]
assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(canonical,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()==canonical_receipt['canonical_sha256']=='c88fc8d3ccf3cab3f1b9919e7da5dafb02fa1cc78de651ee230cee223c9453c2'
def finite(x): return type(x) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(x)
def identity(r): return r['game_id'],r['player_id'],r.get('key',r.get('category'))
def margin_side(v,line,c):
    if not finite(v) or not finite(line): return 'UNAVAILABLE'
    gap=v-line; score=gap/c['scale']
    if abs(gap)<=c['lean'] or abs(score)<policy['minimum_score']: return 'ABSTAIN_MARGIN_OR_MIN_SCORE'
    return 'over' if gap>0 else 'under'
def pre_rank_status(v,pr,c):
